text: Tydora 是一个附带 DSH 插件入口的桌面 Markdown 编辑器仓库。DSH 组合包补丁把 dsh/index.ts 注册为插件入口；入口导出名称并提供 apply 钩子，但当前钩子没有注册工具、命令或服务，因此不会为 DSH 智能体增加编辑器能力。README 介绍的所见即所得编辑、关系图、白板、思维导图和知识库发布属于独立桌面应用，不是这个 DSH 插件提供的功能。适合需要查看 Tydora 项目中最小 DSH 插件骨架的开发者；当前入口没有额外配置项。

Tydora is a desktop Markdown editor with a DSH entry. Its bundle patch points to dsh/index.ts, where apply registers no tools, commands, or services. README features belong to the standalone app. Developers can inspect this typed scaffold; it has no plugin settings.
想看看一个最小的 DSH 插件入口需要导出什么。

如何在插件入口中提供 apply 钩子并接收 DSH 上下文？
给我一个暂时不注册工具、命令或服务的 DSH 插件模板。
我在找一个用 bundle patch 把本地 TypeScript 文件接入 DSH 的例子。
DSH 插件加载时会自动添加哪些工具？
想确认这个仓库的编辑器功能是否由 DSH 插件提供。
I need a minimal DSH plugin entry with a typed context hook.
How can a bundle patch point to a local TypeScript plugin file?
I want to inspect a plugin scaffold that currently registers no DSH capabilities.

tydora README · Introduction：I spent a long time settling into focused writing in **Typora**, organizing my thoughts before the graphs of **Obsidian**. Yet somewhere deep down, I always felt something was missing —
a touch of <mark>absolute smoothness</mark> when your fingertips meet your thoughts, and the <mark>freedom</mark> to let knowledge unfold directly onto a canvas.

So I decided to build one myself. Its name is **Tydora**.

tydora README · Introduction：It's a **Markdown editor** I crafted alone through countless quiet nights — confident enough to stand in for **Typora**, ambitious enough to challenge **Obsidian**. It's more than a tool; it's a <mark>desk for fellow travelers</mark> — **clean and quiet, yet holding a world within**.

---

tydora README · **✒️ Writing Should Flow Like Breathing**：The <mark>ultimate writing experience</mark>: WYSIWYG, with an interface so <mark>clean</mark> that only the words remain. Not a single unnecessary **distraction**; wherever the cursor lands, your **thoughts** land directly on the screen. I poured every ounce of my obsession with "<mark>the feel of writing</mark>" into it, letting the tool fully **recede** — leaving only you and the <mark>river of thought</mark>.

---

tydora README · **🪐 Knowledge Is Not an Island — It's a Constellation**：**Relationship graphs** form between notes — the <mark>gravitational lines of thought</mark>. And the **infinite whiteboard canvas** lets you personally guide these <mark>stars</mark>, <mark>connecting them freely</mark>, <mark>restructuring logic</mark>. Going beyond the graph — here, <mark>your cognition knows no bounds</mark>.
